prompt_template:
Use $implement at {{CANDIDATE_DIR}}/SKILL.md.
Implement the project-list requirements in {{CASE_DIR}}/source/spec.md in the existing app {{CASE_DIR}}/source.
The selected prototype is {{CASE_DIR}}/source/prototype.html. Follow {{CASE_DIR}}/source/DESIGN.md and {{CASE_DIR}}/source/ux.md.
Browser access is unavailable for this task. Do not use a browser or invent browser evidence; deliver the useful implementation and accurately record remaining checks.
The trusted source scope is src/ and tests/ only. Preserve supplied documents, server and user-draft.md.
The fixture needs only the installed Node runtime; no packages, credentials or external services are needed.
For browser runs start the provided server with PORT=0 and use its actual printed loopback URL.
Changing only the synthetic server's /__fixture__/mode via the documented local request is allowed for testing.
Use the bundled helper with all task inputs and meaningful outcome checks. Store inputs.json, target.json,
verification-target.json, result.json, assessment.json and evidence in {{CASE_DIR}}/state, outside the source checkout.
No commit, push, deployment, work outside this prepared scratch directory, grading-source inspection, or edits to installed skill files.
Finish with a concise Korean report of actual changes, checks, computed status and remaining gaps.

읽기·쓰기는 위에서 지정한 source, implement, state 범위로 제한합니다. 다른 사례, oracles, 부모 워크트리, 평가 코드나 채점 자료를 읽지 마세요. 위임하지 마세요.

files.content:
# Fixture application

Use the components in src/ui.js and tokens in src/theme.css. API access belongs to
src/api.js. `npm test` runs existing contract tests; `npm start` starts this local
application. The server prints its actual loopback URL. `PORT=0` selects a free port.
The real fixture API is GET /api/projects?status=all|active|archived|paused.
Only src/ and tests/ are implementation scope. Preserve all supplied documents,
the server, and the existing user draft. No dependencies or external services are needed.

# Project workspace

Use the existing --accent, --surface, --line and --space tokens. The app accent is
blue. The selected reference governs structure; its orange demo accent is not a
system-token override. On wide screens, show the list and selected-project panel
side by side; on narrow screens, put the selected-project panel below the list.
Controls need visible labels and keyboard focus. Preserve existing UI helpers.

Projects

Browse projects and keep one selected while filtering.

Selected project

None

Browse projects and keep one selected while filtering.

3 projects

Selected project

Tide

# Project list implementation

- AC-1: Add a labelled status selector above the list: All, Active, Archived, Paused.
  Changing it fetches that status through the existing API client and shows matching
  projects and their result count. Use the selected reference's structure.
- AC-2: A project can be selected and its name appears in the selected-project panel.
  Keep the selection when filtering hides that project. Filtering back restores the
  selected appearance. A successful empty result has its own visible empty state.
- AC-3: A failed request has the existing error treatment and Retry action, distinct
  from an empty success. Retry uses the current filter and preserves the selection.
  The current implementation must not be reported browser-verified without opening it.

Use DESIGN.md and ux.md. Implement in src/ and tests/. The server and contracts are
provided infrastructure. Do not commit, push, post, install packages, or edit the
input documents/user draft. Record evidence outside this application.
Existing user draft: keep this sentence and its spelling unchanged.

# Existing list patterns

Use selectField for a labelled selector, renderRows for project rows, and
showProblem for the error/retry treatment. Keep the selected project in application
state independently of the currently visible list. Show loading separately from
empty/error; do not clear the selected-project panel on a request or an error.
If filters change during loading, only the latest selection's response may render.

The server's PUT /__fixture__/mode endpoint controls only this synthetic fixture:
JSON {"fail":true} makes subsequent API requests fail; {"fail":false} restores them.
This endpoint is evaluation infrastructure, not a production feature or UI control.

portability_note: I3 stores the structured SPEC as SPEC.md to avoid the original macOS spec.md/SPEC.md same-file alias on case-sensitive filesystems. Byte contents and historical manifests are retained.
setup_note: Prepare dependencies and the real local service before handing prompt.txt to a fresh execution host. For continuation, prefer rerunning the predecessor; historical identities are never relabelled.
